prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic pink monochrome fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman lying on a glossy pink studio floor with a clear reflection.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with shoulder-length blonde soft waves, natural soft-glam makeup, calm composed expression and visible natural skin texture. She wears a coordinated dusty-rose sleeveless draped top and full-length ribbed wide-leg pants with a thin black wrist band.
composition_elements: Subject lies on her back with arms relaxed outward and legs together, captured in an upside-down editorial orientation with a crisp floor reflection below.
Monochromatic pink curved studio environment with subtle horizontal gradient bands and low-reflective glossy floor.
Preserve hair spread, garment drape, reflection symmetry, wrist band and soft graphic palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal studio illumination with low contrast, gentle highlights on the glossy floor, controlled pink ambient fill and minimal soft shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 50mm lens at f/5.6, sharp subject and reflection, realistic skin pores, ribbed fabric and floor reflection, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
